activities.description: I didn't use all ten slots; however, I think it was a good idea because I was able to focus my energy into a clearer narrative for the admissions officers. Any other clubs/extracurriculars I pursued had little to no impact in my eyes. Eventually, I'd shorten these descriptions to fit the Common App, but here's the full range of accomplishments. Some information I redacted cause it would give away where I live.
